steps: Caller asks a privileged service to access a resource.
Service refuses to rely on its ambient authority alone.
Authorization binds caller identity, action, and exact target.
A narrowed token prevents redirecting privilege to another resource.

lesson.scenario: An image-conversion service must not use its storage privilege to fetch an attacker-selected object from another tenant.

steps.title: Receive attacker-selected input
steps.narration: Tenant Red asks the converter to fetch a Tenant Blue path while presenting a valid conversion token for tenant-red.

authz.detail: No work accepted in this phase

storage.detail: No work accepted in this phase

victim.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: The converter recognizes a cross-tenant target.
steps.invariant: The deputy binds caller identity, delegated action, tenant, and exact resource before exercising any privileged downstream credential.

steps.title: Bind caller intent to target
steps.narration: Policy requires token tenant_id to equal object owner and signed request target to equal the storage resource.

storage.detail: No work accepted in this phase

victim.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.invariant: The deputy binds caller identity, delegated action, tenant, and exact resource before exercising any privileged downstream credential.

steps.title: Prevent privileged read
steps.narration: The converter does not use its broad storage identity after the policy denial, so Storage never receives a read for the victim path.
steps.outcome: The deputy cannot be tricked into exercising ambient authority.
steps.invariant: The deputy binds caller identity, delegated action, tenant, and exact resource before exercising any privileged downstream credential.

steps.title: Issue resource-bound authority
steps.narration: A valid request names tenant-red, exact object red/uploads/cat.png, conversion action, and five-minute expiry.
steps.outcome: The deputy receives narrow authority for one object.
steps.invariant: The deputy binds caller identity, delegated action, tenant, and exact resource before exercising any privileged downstream credential.

steps.title: Use only the bound capability
steps.narration: Storage verifies the capability audience, object path, action, and expiry rather than trusting converter identity alone.
steps.outcome: The legitimate conversion completes without ambient cross-tenant access.
steps.invariant: The deputy binds caller identity, delegated action, tenant, and exact resource before exercising any privileged downstream credential.
